fusions.name: Thunder Arrives
fusions.desc: You crash in among them, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and is always a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Snapping at the Gallop
fusions.desc: A running bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hoofbeats in Time
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. A packmate runs beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Legged Stride
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
